name: @yagr/agent
description: Autonomous automation agent grounded in deterministic workflow infrastructure

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && tsc -b && node scripts/build-webui.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @yagr/runtime-events && npm run build --workspace @yagr/conversation-core && npm run build --workspace @yagr/plugin-runtime && npm run build --workspace @yagr/session-memory && npm run build --workspace @yagr/session-checkpoint && npm run build --workspace @yagr/webui-session-registry && npm run build --workspace @yagr/provider-runtime && npm run build --workspace @yagr/deepagent-bootstrap && npm run build --workspace @yagr/session-service && npm run build --workspace @yagr/conversation-service && npm run build --workspace @yagr/gateway-core && npm run build --workspace @yagr/stream-adapter && npm run build --workspace @yagr/webui-surface && npm run build --workspace @yagr/tui-surface && npm run build --workspace @yagr/runtime && npm run build --workspace @yagr/surfaces
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:clean:symlink: npm run clean && npm run build && node --eval "import('fs').then(({chmodSync})=>chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755))" && npm link
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "const {rmSync,readdirSync}=await import('node:fs'); const targets=['dist','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo','node_modules/.cache',...readdirSync('packages').map(p=>`packages/${p}/dist`)]; for (const target of targets) rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace @yagr/plugin-runtime && npm run test --workspace @yagr/session-memory && npm run test --workspace @yagr/session-service

author: Etienne Lescot
